soft_regions.name: seal_patch

selection.selector: Lower annular recessed dark strip .18<r<.205, abs(X)<.065, Z<.31 and -.30<Y<-.23, bounded by the inner metallic bowl and outer raised door lip. Follow its connected folded surface; remove these faces from all rigid ownership.
selection.reason: A small lower sealing-lip segment gives a cheap visible nonrigid attempt; reflections alone do not define its material.

soft_regions.reason: Folded dark annulus around rigid metal/glazing plausibly includes a compliant seal. Attempt one active patch with real contact and native render binding; do not call untested rubber a measured material.

native_to_metric_scale.reason: Human-scale height prior; numerical native bounds are observed, SI scale is not.

interactions.name: rigid_endpoints
interactions.action: Within one host attempt: rest; open door 0,pi/4,pi/2; exercise slides at 0,half,max and return; rotate drum and selector with unwrapped targets 0,pi,2*pi then stop, without adding mechanical stops. Control press returns to zero.
interactions.expected: Native door rim visibly follows hinge while metallic interior stays independent; drawer and cover move separately; controls move on correct surfaces. Record actual endpoints, continuity and failures.

interactions.name: seal_test
interactions.action: With door open, pin patch perimeter to cabinet, press center along +Y with contact probe for bounded load, unload and recover. Use actual flex trajectory for the dedicated native surface.
interactions.expected: Measure differential surface displacement from pinned perimeter, finite strain and recovery; report failure honestly if unstable or inadequate. Rigid follow cannot satisfy this test.

review_requirements: Check the built native-face ledger and a colored ownership view: every source face has exactly one owner, original geometry/UV/PBR are retained, each planned moving part has its intended visible surface, and seal_patch has no rigid duplicate. Inspect door rim/glazing versus metallic drum and lower seal boundaries; do not let a broad mask move fixed fascia or substitute an unrelated region for the press control. Measure the two named additions against individual and combined approved area caps.

Using cheap forward transforms and visible surface samples, check door at 0, pi/4 and pi/2 and drawer/press/cover at minimum, midpoint and maximum declared slide travel. Door hinge attachment must remain at its cabinet pivot; drawer carrier must remain inserted with the proposed 0.06 m overlap at full pull; press stays seated. Cover separation is intentional constrained removal, so check alignment and reseating rather than an invented tether. Inspect drum/selector at representative quarter-turn poses for stable axial seating. Record gaps without reconstructing detailed interiors or running another simulation.

Verify drum_spin and selector_turn compile as hinge limited=false with no range or finite actuator angle bounds. In the single host attempt use unwrapped one-or-more-turn targets and record actual cumulative angles and failures. Compare tracked native vertices at intermediate poses, not only the full-turn endpoint, to show drum rotates independently of door and selector independently of fascia. Confirm door opening moves the intended rim outward while drum, cabinet and seal support do not follow it; honor supported GLB/MuJoCo offsets.

Build seal_patch with real nonempty flex elements, free interior nodes and cabinet attachment, plus an exclusive native skin. Check nonnegative weights summing to one and rest reconstruction within 0.001 of metric native diagonal. Within the sole host dynamics attempt, with door open, record actual probe contact, load/unload and recovery; measure differential native-surface displacement relative to pinned boundary and recovery residual, and inspect visible deformation. Rigid follow, empty selection and prescribed vertex animation do not pass. Keep remaining_seal explicitly undeformed and report any failed soft criterion.

In the one bounded host dynamics attempt record finite states, actual rigid travel/endpoints, meaningful visible press/slide displacement and contact outcomes using frozen physics_tolerances.py. A 3 mm press must show actual surface motion even if object-scale endpoint tolerance alone would accept zero motion. Retain simple proxies and report coverage/omissions; the 1 percent diagonal contact allowance requires no extra locality proof, and any extension requires the helper's measured evidence. Never range-limit continuous hinges or report tolerant contact as collision-free validation. Deliver all implemented interactions with separate planned, simulated-success, parameter-preview and failed/missing statuses.

interaction_coverage.label: Open and close front door
interaction_coverage.reason: Image-left rim interruptions and right-side latch-like feature support left hinge; vertical axis is a prior. Preserve full initial 90-degree outward travel.

interaction_coverage.label: Spin visible internal bowl
interaction_coverage.reason: Concentric perforated metal interior supports an independent axial bearing; no observed stops. Unlimited mechanical angle with finite one-turn test.

interaction_coverage.label: Pull and return upper gripped panel
interaction_coverage.reason: Grip and rectangular seam support a front-normal slide; .12 m travel is an editable depth prior.

interaction_coverage.label: Turn selector
interaction_coverage.reason: Projecting circular selector supports axial turning. Stops are not observed; continuous spindle is an explicit editable mechanism prior, not a recovered product fact.

interaction_coverage.label: Press and release front control
interaction_coverage.reason: Raised small button supports .003 m inward travel with return, a constrained press prior justified by control scale.

interaction_coverage.label: Pull off and replace lower cover
interaction_coverage.reason: Notch and seam support access. Constrained outward removal approximates a snap cover; no invented hinge claimed.

interaction_coverage.label: Compress and recover local seal
interaction_coverage.reason: At least one actual flex region must produce visible nonrigid native-surface displacement under contact.

interaction_coverage.label: Additional seal response
interaction_coverage.reason: Secondary seal deformation is outside the single coarse active-patch attempt.

deferred_compliance.name: remaining_seal
deferred_compliance.reason: Other recessed sealing annulus faces outside the active lower patch retain native fixed ownership with no deformation claim; moving glass/door trim is excluded.

approximation_gaps.reason: Native reconstruction may bake glass reflections and obscure depth ownership; partition follows observable inner bowl versus rim and keeps all native faces. Rear and exposed interior surfaces are neural hypotheses, with no hidden-interior reconstruction.
Small hinge bridge and drawer carrier are estimated added connectors within reviewed budgets; door backs, drawer cavity and cover fasteners remain incomplete.
Simple wall/rim/bowl proxies approximate detailed contact; no all-pose collision-free claim. Record policy-tolerated contacts and large failures without shrinking continuous joints.
Only one small seal patch deforms; remaining possible seal follows cabinet unchanged without a successful deformation claim.
